description: This file contains system call wrappers and utility functions for Linux on ARM64 architecture, including definitions for epoll, file operations, process limits, socket operations, and system call implementations.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: Wrapper for the pselect6 system call with optional timeout.

methods.name: Stat
methods.description: Wrapper for the Fstatat system call to get file status.

methods.name: Lchown
methods.description: Wrapper for the Fchownat system call to change ownership of a symbolic link.

methods.name: Lstat
methods.description: Wrapper for the Fstatat system call to get file status, following symlinks.

methods.name: Ustat
methods.description: Stub function returning ENOSYS, indicating unsupported operation.

methods.name: setTimespec
methods.description: Creates a Timespec struct from seconds and nanoseconds.

methods.name: setTimeval
methods.description: Creates a Timeval struct from seconds and microseconds.

methods.name: futimesat
methods.description: Sets file access and modification times using timespecs.

methods.name: Time
methods.description: Gets the current time of day and optionally sets a provided variable.

methods.name: Utime
methods.description: Sets file access and modification times based on Utimbuf.

methods.name: utimes
methods.description: Sets file times using Timeval structures.

methods.name: Getrlimit
methods.description: Retrieves resource limits, preferring prlimit64 syscall.

methods.name: PC
methods.description: Getter for the program counter register in PtraceRegs.

methods.name: SetPC
methods.description: Setter for the program counter register in PtraceRegs.

methods.name: SetLen
methods.description: Sets the length field in an Iovec struct.

methods.name: SetControllen
methods.description: Sets the controllen field in an Msghdr struct.

methods.name: SetIovlen
methods.description: Sets the iovlen field in an Msghdr struct.

methods.name: SetLen
methods.description: Sets the length field in a Cmsghdr struct.

methods.name: SetServiceNameLen
methods.description: Sets the service name length in RawSockaddrNFCLLCP struct.

methods.name: Pause
methods.description: Wraps ppoll to wait for a signal.

methods.name: KexecFileLoad
methods.description: Loads a new kernel image for kexec, handling null-terminated string length.
